source.chapter_title: Effects of Mesha and other signs being the Lagna

notes: Slokas 15-19: how the sign a planet occupies colours its whole dasha.

skipped.reason: Dasha of a combust planet: death and ruin, excluded by policy.

rules.text: Dasha of a planet in its own sign: power and strength through a wealthy patron or in one's own right, a settled residence, a new house and productive land, honour among one's people, and recovery of lost things.
Dasha of a planet in a friend's sign: success through friends, new friendships, and good fortune in children, spouse, wealth and provisions, with help from all sides.
Dasha of a planet in an enemy's sign: low spirits, dependence on others, hardship and harassment from opponents; even old friends may turn hostile.
Dasha of a debilitated planet: loss of position and humiliation, debts, reliance on unworthy people, poor surroundings, menial work and wasted effort.
